answer.words: The Orion fact_positions accountNumber column qualifies under the round-111 rule: one value per account, a digit run of 4 or more on every dry-run account, unique per account, and the same value across five sampled dated partitions. Two other columns also qualify (Orion fact_assets accountNumber and Eclipse fact_portfolios_simple accountNumber); the named field is the one the round-111 ruling referred to. The CVO graded rendered labels that showed text fragments; this read measures the stored values and does not explain those fragments. 73 accounts carry an alphabetic character in the newest value (counts only).

denominator.scope_words: Orion columns are measured over the 980 accounts of the round-108 dry-run table. The one account-keyed Eclipse table, fact_portfolios_simple, is measured over its distinct account keys of its newest partition (753 keys, inside the 980 bound). The three keyless Eclipse tables and fact_performance carry no account key, so their account shares are zero. Shape partition: the newest dated partition of each table; fact_portfolios_simple newest is 2026-10-09. Stability: up to five dated partitions per table over the last 120 calendar days, excluding the two alien dates.

positive_control.description: The same measure and the same qualifying rule run on two in-memory columns over 100 accounts and three dated partitions: an 8-digit number unique per account and stable across partitions, and a five-word fragment repeated across accounts.
positive_control.expected: The number column qualifies and the fragment column does not.
positive_control.observed: The number column qualifies and the fragment column does not.
